# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_TIGHTEN_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's current VIX filter (VIX rising OR ≥20) admits losing put trades on 5/05 and 5/06. Tightening the VIX threshold to ≥22 will exclude these losing days while preserving winner days, as extreme VIX regimes (>22) correlate with sustained bearish momentum that favors ribbon rides.

## Mechanism

Modify the VIX confirmation filter in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entry logic: require VIX ≥ 22.0 at time of entry (replacing "VIX rising OR already above 20"). All other context filters, trigger, entry, stop, and target logic remain unchanged. This is a pure filter tightening at the watcher/entry gate level.
